title: A census of the whole public root dated after 2026-10-20 records a verdict or a reading outcome for every live source, and dates only what it confirmed
goal: kb/public/_census/<date>.csv, dated after 2026-10-20, holds a row for every source of kb/public/_sources.csv with no superseded_by that predates the census (a row the census added carries its date); every row not OK has an outcome from phase 2 (confirmed, updated, superseded, gone or unconfirmed); phase 3 dated each OK or confirmed source to the census date and no earlier; the fact count of the public root does not fall, since a changed fact is reworded or superseded, never deleted (anchor rows re-checked in phase 2 for: S-7ziha7pr S-esun5f2n S-i6b6z3is S-jbhevlal S-ka3u6g4r S-kzoop7qs S-l4557zht S-lekwizgd S-lsfxdurw S-nonpog4d S-ntqzc5fg S-t7fbkn25 S-tkwapxy3 S-udcaydkb S-v53altt3 S-woho7bmc S-x7eqxwa3 S-zlqf57iu S1200 S1217 S1400 S1401 S1402 S1418 S1419 S1805 S1885 S1899 S1900 S1962 S1970 S1977 S2162 S2163 S2166 S2167 S2171)

run:
import csv, glob, os, sys
F = '2026-10-20'
logs = sorted(p for p in glob.glob('kb/public/_census/20*.csv') if os.path.basename(p)[:10] > F)
if not logs:
    print('no census log dated after', F); sys.exit(1)
d = os.path.basename(logs[-1])[:10]
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open(logs[-1], encoding='utf-8')))
src = {r['id']: r for r in csv.DictReader(open('kb/public/_sources.csv', encoding='utf-8'))}
ids = {r['id'] for r in rows}
miss = [i for i, r in src.items() if not r.get('superseded_by') and i not in ids and r['retrieved_utc'][:10] < d]
unread = [r['id'] for r in rows if r['bucket'] != 'OK' and not r['outcome']]
undated = [r['id'] for r in rows if (r['bucket'] == 'OK' or r['outcome'] == 'confirmed') and r['id'] in src and src[r['id']]['retrieved_utc'][:10] < d]
print(logs[-1], len(rows), 'rows;', len(miss), 'live sources not in it;', len(unread), 'non-OK rows with no outcome;', len(undated), 'confirmed sources dated before', d)
sys.exit(1 if miss or unread or undated else 0)

import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '_tools')
import kbfacts
P, B = ('',), 16886
n = sum(len(kbfacts.units('public/' + p)) for p in P)
print(n, 'fact units under', P, '- at least', B, 'on 2026-10-20')
sys.exit(0 if n >= B else 1)

Fact units of the public root on 2026-10-20: 16886. check.py and the fact-count check pass before the work and must stay passing: they pin the kb's structure rules and that no fact is deleted across the rewrites (2026-10-20 planning).
